scripts.build: npm run build:core && vite build && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:cli: npm run build --workspace @seymi/clipnest-core && npm run build --workspace @seymi/clipnest-cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @seymi/clipnest-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @seymi/clipnest-cli
scripts.typecheck:bun: concurrently -n root,core,cli -c auto "bun check --skipLibCheck" "bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck:bun" "bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck:bun"
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format: prettier --write "**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json}" && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json}" && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
scripts.tauri:build: tauri build && cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --bin clipnest-cli && bun run scripts/build-portable.ts
scripts.tauri:portable: tauri build --no-bundle && cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --bin clipnest-cli && bun run scripts/build-portable.ts
